cards.ask: Damma or mansub?
items: A single proper name, like يا زيد
An intended indefinite, like يا رجل
source: فأما المفرد العلم والنكرة المقصودة فيبنيان على الضم من غير تنوين
cards.why: Two kinds are fixed on damma. The remaining three are mansub.

cards.ask: Ali calls to a particular man standing in front of him: "O man!" How is رجل read?
cards.source: والنكرة المقصودة فيبنيان على الضم من غير تنوين، نحو: "يا زيد" و"يا رجل"
cards.why: A particular man he means is an intended indefinite, fixed on damma with no tanwin.

cards.ask: How many kinds of munada are mansub, and nothing else?
cards.source: والثلاثة الباقية منصوبة لا غير.
cards.why: Of the five kinds, two are fixed on damma and the remaining three are mansub.

lessons.title: For the sake of, and along with

cards.title: The reason-object
cards.ar: وهو: الاسم المنصوب الذي يذكر بيانا لسبب وقوع الفعل، نحو قولك: "قام زيد إجلالا لعمرو" و"قصدتك ابتغاء معروفك".
cards.en: The maf'ul li-ajlih (reason-object) is the mansub noun mentioned to give the reason the action happened: قام زيد إجلالًا لعمرو, "Zayd stood out of respect for 'Amr"; قصدتك ابتغاء معروفك, "I came to you seeking your kindness".

cards.ask: Which word completes it?
cards.ar: "قام زيد ____ لعمرو"
cards.source: "قام زيد إجلالا لعمرو"
cards.why: The reason-object is mansub: إجلالًا, "out of respect".

cards.ask: In قصدتك ابتغاء معروفك, why is ابتغاء mansub?
options: It gives the reason for coming
It is a word of time
It is a hal, telling how I came
cards.source: و"قصدتك ابتغاء معروفك"
cards.why: "Seeking your kindness" is why I came to you, so it is the reason-object.

cards.title: The with-object
cards.ar: وهو: الاسم المنصوب الذي يذكر لبيان من فعل معه الفعل، نحو قولك: "جاء الأمير والجيش" و"استوى الماء والخشبة".
cards.en: The maf'ul ma'ahu (with-object) is the mansub noun mentioned to show who or what the action was done along with: جاء الأميرُ والجيشَ, "the commander came along with the army"; استوى الماءُ والخشبةَ, "the water rose level with the post". The wa here means "with".

cards.ask: Ali says سرتُ والنيلَ, "I walked along with the Nile". What is النيل?
cards.source: وهو: الاسم المنصوب الذي يذكر لبيان من فعل معه الفعل
cards.why: The Nile is what the walking was done along with, after a wa meaning "with", so it is the with-object, mansub.

cards.ask: In جاء الأمير والجيش, why is الجيش mansub?
options: It is the with-object: "with the army"
It is the object of جاء
cards.source: "جاء الأمير والجيش"
cards.why: The book gives it as a with-object, which is mansub. A word joined to الأمير by 'atf would be raised like him.

cards.title: Already covered
cards.ar: وأما خبر "كان" وأخواتها، واسم "إن" وأخواتها، فقد تقدم ذكرهما في المرفوعات، وكذلك التوابع فقد تقدمت هناك.
cards.en: The khabar of kana and the noun of inna were already explained with the raised nouns, and so were the followers.

cards.ask: Which accusative is it?
items: إجلالا in قام زيد إجلالا لعمرو
source: الذي يذكر بيانا لسبب وقوع الفعل
الذي يذكر لبيان من فعل معه الفعل
cards.why: Respect and seeking give reasons. The army and the post are "with". Riding tells the state.

cards.ask: In إن زيدا قائم, which word is in the accusative list?
cards.why: The noun of inna is among the fifteen accusatives. Its khabar stays raised.

cards.ask: Which of these are among the accusative nouns?
cards.source: والمنادى، والمفعول من أجله، والمفعول معه، وخبر كان وأخواتها
cards.why: These four are in the list of fifteen. The doer and the subject are raised nouns.

cards.title: Three kinds
cards.ar: مخفوض بالحرف، ومخفوض بالإضافة، وتابع للمخفوض.
cards.en: Makhfud (genitive) nouns are of three kinds: made genitive by a particle, made genitive by idafa (a noun joined to the noun before it), and a follower of a genitive word.

cards.ask: How many kinds of genitive noun are there?
cards.source: مخفوض بالحرف، ومخفوض بالإضافة، وتابع للمخفوض.
cards.why: Three: by a particle, by idafa, and as a follower of a genitive word.

cards.ask: Which of these are kinds of genitive noun?

options.text: A follower of a genitive word

cards.source: مخفوض بالحرف، ومخفوض بالإضافة، وتابع للمخفوض.
cards.why: The three kinds are by a particle, by idafa, and as a follower. A verb and la do not make a noun genitive.

cards.title: By a particle
cards.ar: فأما المخفوض بالحرف فهو: ما يخفض بمن، وإلى، وعن، وعلى، وفي، ورب، والباء، والكاف، واللام، وبحروف القسم، وهي: الواو، والباء، والتاء، وبواو رب، وبمذ، ومنذ.
cards.en: Made genitive by a particle: after min (from), ila (to), 'an (away from), 'ala (on), fi (in), rubba (many a), bi (with), ka (like), li (for); the oath letters wa, bi and ta; the waw of rubba; and mudh and mundhu (since).

cards.ask: Which of these make the next noun genitive?
cards.source: ما يخفض بمن، وإلى، وعن، وعلى، وفي
cards.why: Min, fi, mundhu and the oath waw make a noun genitive. Lan and lam work on verbs.

cards.ask: Which word completes it?
cards.ar: فأما المخفوض بالحرف فهو: ما يخفض بمن، ____، وعن
cards.source: فأما المخفوض بالحرف فهو: ما يخفض بمن، وإلى، وعن
cards.why: Ila ("to") is the second of the genitive particles. Lan and qad come before verbs.

cards.title: By idafa
cards.ar: وأما ما يخفض بالإضافة , فنحو قولك: "غلام زيد" وهو على قسمين: ما يقدر باللام، وما يقدر بمن، فالذي يقدر باللام، نحو: "غلام زيد"
cards.en: Made genitive by idafa: غلامُ زيدٍ, "Zayd's ghulam (servant boy)". Zayd is genitive. It has two kinds: one where li ("belonging to") is understood, as in غلام زيد, the boy belonging to Zayd; and one where min ("made of") is understood.

cards.title: With min understood
cards.ar: والذي يقدر بمن، نحو: "ثوب خز" و"باب ساج" و"خاتم حديد". تم بحمد الله
cards.en: With min understood: ثوبُ خزٍّ, "a garment of khazz (silk mixed with wool)"; بابُ ساجٍ, "a door of teak"; خاتمُ حديدٍ, "a ring of iron". And there the book ends: "Complete, with praise to Allah."

cards.ask: Why is it genitive?
source: ... باب المخفوضات الأسماء المخفوضات ثلاثة أنواع
مخفوض بالحرف، ومخفوض بالإضافة، وتابع للمخفوض.
cards.why: بِ is a particle of khafd. زيد and حديد are the second noun of an idafa. العاقل and عمرو follow a genitive word (a na't and an 'atf).

cards.ask: Hamid has a ring made of iron: خاتم حديد. What is understood between the two words?
options: Li: a ring belonging to iron
cards.source: والذي يقدر بمن، نحو: "ثوب خز" و"باب ساج" و"خاتم حديد"
cards.why: The ring is made of iron, so min is understood.

cards.ask: In غلام زيد, which word is genitive, and why?
cards.source: وأما ما يخفض بالإضافة , فنحو قولك: "غلام زيد"
cards.why: The second noun of an idafa is genitive: غلامُ زيدٍ. No particle comes before Zayd.

cards.ask: In مررت بزيد العاقل, why is العاقل genitive?
options: A particle comes right before it
It is in idafa with Zayd
cards.source: وتابع للمخفوض.
cards.why: Zayd is genitive after بِ, and العاقل, his describing word, follows him.
